en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large wooden seaside pavilion-style building on a brick foundation, with wide exterior staircases leading up to a central entrance and wraparound verandas. A square tower with a flagpole rises on the right side of the structure. Trees frame the scene, and a person stands on the lawn in the foreground. Printed caption text appears below the image.
